post.description: Live whale-tracking on Polymarket: the latest large trades (default >= 5000 USD, tunable via min_usd) with wallet, side, outcome, size, price, USD value, market title/slug and tx hash, straight from Polymarket public trades data API. Built for prediction-market agents that track smart money before trading. No charge on service failure. Ed25519-signed. $0.15 USDC per call via x402 on Base. Free trial: 3 calls per wallet with header X-WALLET.
